item.title: Return a reusable stadium cup
item.context_text: You borrowed a cup at a match. You want to tell a friend where to return it and get the deposit back.
item.objective_text: Find a return station and explain how the deposit works.
success_conditions: Find a return station and explain how the deposit works.

children.title: Read the information
children.instructions: Read the note and use its details to answer both questions.
children.prompt_text:
STADIUM CUP RETURN
A reusable cup costs a 10,000 som deposit. You get it back when you return the cup and show the small deposit ticket. Return booths beside Gates A and C are open until 21:30. After 21:00, Gate A is exit-only and staff direct visitors to the booth at Gate C. Your group will leave at 21:10.

questions.prompt: Which booth should your group use?
options: Any gate without a return booth
questions.explanation: After 21:00 visitors must use the Gate C booth. Your group leaves later.

questions.prompt: What else should you show with the cup?
questions.explanation: The rules require the deposit ticket along with the cup.

children.title: Explain the return to a friend
children.prompt_text: Friend: Can I get my money back after the match?
children.instructions: Name the gate and the document to show.
children.model_answer: Yes, take the cup to the booth at Gate C before half past nine. Keep the small deposit ticket to show them.

children.title: Request the refund
children.prompt_text: Worker: Good evening. What can I do for you?
children.instructions: Hand back the cup and ask for the deposit.
children.model_answer: I am returning this cup and here is my ticket. Could I have my deposit back, please?
